versions.changelog:
Initial release of backup-3-2-1-auditor.

- Audits personal data backup setups against the 3-2-1 rule (3 copies, 2 media types, 1 offsite), for each asset.
- Analyzes ransomware "blast radius" by marking which backups would be lost alongside the originals.
- Prices realistic data recovery costs per asset class (e.g., baby photos, code repos).
- Generates a minimum-cost, actionable redundancy plan for each asset.
- Includes a quarterly restore-test drill, emphasizing tested backups.
- Python standard library only, offline, with local JSON registry.
